faqs.question: How is responsive web design different from mobile-friendly web design?
faqs.answer: Responsive design automatically adapts the layout to different screen sizes, while mobile-friendly design mainly focuses on making a website usable on mobile devices.

faqs.question: What is the difference between adaptive design and responsive design?
faqs.answer: Responsive design fluidly adjusts to screen sizes, while adaptive design uses predefined layouts for specific screen sizes.

faqs.question: Can responsive design improve my website’s search engine rankings?
faqs.answer: Yes. A responsive, mobile-friendly website can improve user experience and support better search engine performance.

faqs.question: How long does it take to make our existing website responsive?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the website's size, structure, and complexity. We provide an estimated timeline after reviewing the website.

faqs.question: Will a responsive design slow down my website on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: No. With optimized images, code, and performance techniques, responsive websites can load quickly and provide a smooth mobile experience.
